decisive_items: Epsilon wave present in lead V4
Grossly dilated RV, high RV end diastolic volume of 219.9 mL, RVOT diameter of 31 mm, RV ejection fraction of 19.3%
Postcontrast hyperenhancement along RV free wall, RVOT apical wall, RV aspect of septum
response.rationale: R2 integrates ECG epsilon wave, RV structural/functional abnormalities on echo and MRI, and postcontrast enhancement, matching ARVC. R1 only describes the presenting wide complex tachycardia, which is a manifestation of ARVC rather than the underlying diagnosis.

rejected.why: Wide complex tachycardia is a nonspecific arrhythmia; the underlying structural and ECG findings point to ARVC.
